ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the food web below, what is considered a carnivore?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, labeled with organisms such as cougar, Spotted owl, Red tree vole, Mountain beaver, Flying squirrel, Black-Tailed deer, Pileated woodpecker, Winter wren, Douglas fir tree needles, Fern, berries, lichen, fungi, acorn, Carpenter ant, aphid, caterpillar, etc. In the diagram there are arrows from some animals (such as Mountain beaver, Flying squirrel) pointing to cougar, indicating that the energy of these animals flows to cougar. Reasoning: A carnivore is an organism that eats other animals. In the diagram, cougar receives energy from other animals, showing that it preys on animals, therefore it is considered a carnivore.
